description: Defines the ViewerSurfaceFlinger class, a viewer component for Surface Flinger trace data, including event handling, view creation, and dependencies.

classes.name: ViewerSurfaceFlinger
classes.description: A viewer class for Surface Flinger trace data, managing event listeners, trace updates, and view rendering.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the viewer with traces and storage, sets up event listeners, and creates the main HTML element.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to the trace position by delegating to the presenter.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Returns an array with a single View instance representing the Surface Flinger viewer tab.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns the list of trace types this viewer depends on.
